name: pagination-10
description: Full-width mobile pagination with large tap targets and a centered page counter.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/pagination" const TOTAL = 9 export default function CompactMobilePagination() { const [page, setPage] = React.useState(4) return ( { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1)) }} /> {page} / {TOTAL} { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.min(TOTAL, p + 1)) }} /> ) }
